effect: CONTROL: software-RESET MAIN when 0xFF8DDE bit7 clear (jsr sub_2648; orc #0x80,ccr; jmp loc_2050). When 0xFF8DDE bit7 SET: identify/handshake, copies 55-byte FT3D identify frame to 0xFEE000, fills destination(USA/JPN/EXP tbl 0x6BE24)/model/serial fields. Same reset also inline in frame assembler at 0x6B7DC.

SETTINGS-WRITE (RAM only): model/destination exchange. Echoes 74 or 76 received frame bytes 0xFF1AC8->0xFEE000, patches model/dest digits, sets RAM config vars 0xFFB12F-31 from 0xFFB3D4. No EEPROM/flash write.
1-byte status get/ack. When 0xFF8DDE.7 & 0xFFB3E5!=0: clears 0xFFB3E5, sets state 0xFFB3E4=1, calls loc_1CA72 (radio action). Reply = 8-byte template 0x6C598 -> staging -> finalize.
11-byte record get. sub_6BB6E builds a 2-byte value ->0xFEE007/09, 5 bytes from 0xFF8060 ->0xFEE00B.

Status/data read: gated on 0xFF8ABE.6/0xFFBBE7/0xFF9C62/0xFF9CC4, builds variable frame from FIXED RAM fields 0xFF9C64 and 0xFF9CC6 via sub_6C048 (<=96B each); else fixed 8-byte "N0001 0" fallback. Fixed sources, not arbitrary.
INBOUND: state-machine step (if 0xFFB3E4==3 & frame byte 0xFF1ACE=='0', set 0xFFB3E4=4). OUTBOUND (sub_6C3DE): 72-byte APRS/GPS position record (lat 000.00000, lon +000.00000, date/time).
Header/summary record. 6 template bytes, index via sub_6C10A from 0xFFB3BE and 0xFEEB28/29 ->0xFEE00E/0F, then 20 bytes from 0xFEEB14 ->0xFEE010, EOT.

Block/record READ response, size selected by RAM byte 0xFEEAAC (else/2/3 -> 45/65/90 src bytes -> 97/137/187 frame). Reads FIXED addr 0xFEE944, hex-encodes via sub_6CC4A. Host 4-hex "record index" (0xFFB3D0) is ECHOED into the reply header only (sub_6CC4A), NOT used as an address. NOT an arbitrary-memory read.
11-byte record, shares the C-path tail at 0x6BF12.
FINALIZER: sets DMA-ch2 length 0xFFB3CC = framelen+2, computes 8-bit additive checksum over 0xFEE000 for framelen bytes, appends 2 ASCII-hex digits, sets 0xFFB3D2 bit2 (response ready).

TRANSMIT: arms DMAC ch2 (ctrl 0xFFFC54=0x800001A0, src MAR 0xFFFC40=#0xFEE000 immediate, dst DAR 0xFFFC44=0xFFFE93, count 0xFFFC4C=0xFFB3CC, activation 0xFFFD22=0xA2), sets SCI-A SCR.TIE 0xFFFE92.7. Streams the assembled response frame (<=~194 bytes) from FIXED base 0xFEE000. Source is a hardcoded immediate; host controls neither source address nor length. NOT an arbitrary RAM dump.
LENGTH decoder: applies sub_6CB40 to frame bytes [2][3] and [4][5], returns 16-bit N (payload length). Frame total = N+9.
